name: +1 Speed +1 Jump for Brainrots
desc:
Welcome to +1 Speed +1 Jump for Brainrots! ⚡🧠

Run faster, jump higher, and collect powerful Brainrots as you explore the map!

⚡ Gain Speed & Jump and move faster than everyone!

🧱 Discover Cool Floors with unique challenges!
🤫 Find Hidden Secrets around the map!
🎉 Join Events for special rewards!
🦘 Use Trampolines to jump super high!
💸 Upgrade your Brainrots to earn even more cash!
💰 Rebirth to become even stronger and faster!

💤🤑 Your Brainrots earn CASH while you're OFFLINE!

👍 LIKE the game and JOIN the GROUP for a FREE EXOTIC BRAINROT!
